translations.web: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.
translations.bsb: The waters receded steadily from the earth, and after 150 days the waters had gone down.
translations.kjv: And the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of the hundred and fifty days the waters were abated.
translations.asv: and the waters returned from off the earth continually: and after the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters decreased.
